stories.title: Airbus submits plan to ease congestion
stories.summary: Airbus UK has applied to widen the entrance to its staff car park in Broughton to reduce congestion. During shift changes at the East Factory Car Park – which joins the main road between the Glynne Arms and Station Road Veterinary Surgery, traffic from the wing manufacturer puts daily pressure on the main A5104 route.

stories.title: Man from Shotton jailed after admitting online child sex offences
